validity_findings: Age header not emitted by nginx; stale state verified by elapsed wait (1.5s > max-age=1s) and X-Cache STALE/HIT status rather than Age>max-age header (spec measurement_validity clause 5). This is a documented representation loss vs the frozen spec, but operationally valid for local nginx.

nginx emits X-Cache: STALE (not HIT) for stale serves in SWR and SIE stages. Spec clause 2 expected 'X-Cache: HIT or Age>0'. Producer correctly counts HIT+STALE as stale success (SWR: 120 HIT + 120 STALE = 240; SIE: 240 STALE = 240). Operational interpretation deviates from literal spec wording but correctly captures nginx behavior.

Stage 4 (304 Not Modified): 0/240 true 304 status observed through nginx. nginx proxy_cache with proxy_cache_revalidate on converts origin 304 to 200 MISS serving cached body. Origin correctly emits 304 when bypassing cache (verified direct). The 'substrate correctness' metric (240/240) measures nginx-mediated 304 handling (200 with cached body, no false decompression on empty body) rather than raw 304 forwarding. This is a validity limitation: the 304 no-body wire format was not exercised through the cache layer.

SIE error simulation uses in-process 500 return with proxy_cache_use_stale error, not actual origin process kill. Tests the SIE stale-serving code path but not full origin-unavailability scenario. Documented by producer.

Fixed-order baseline (2041/2041 on local nginx) confirms parent finding that CDN edge transformation (not caching layer) broke fixed-order framing (parent Cloudflare edge: 60/240). This contrast is a strong validation of the byte-preserving cache assumption.

Raw wire bytes (base64) persisted per observation in raw_cell_results.jsonl (sha256 f0328cc2acfbe6dc32f07058b63043a85710482cf392625042c1bc7dd09e7d46) enabling independent recomputation. No representation loss in raw evidence.
Zero duplicate (session_kind, cell, rep, stage) keys across 2047 rows. Zero transport errors. Zero ambiguous tie-breaks (both brotli and gzip succeed at same iteration) across all observations.

claim_ceiling: Oracle-free greedy iterative decompression (brotli->gzip, MAX_DEPTH=5, no SHA256 oracle) produces byte-identical output to ground truth across all five cache lifecycle stages (fresh HIT, SWR stale HIT, SIE stale HIT, 304-revalidated substrate, 200 re-fetched) through local nginx 1.24.0 proxy_cache with byte-preserving behavior. Claim ceiling is explicitly bounded to nginx-class byte-preserving caches; production CDN (Cloudflare paid-tier, Fastly, Akamai, CloudFront) stale-serving byte behavior remains untested and is the same unknown as the parent handoff.
